title: motion-strip zoom= CLI override and new default strip altitude have no automated test
detail: Duplicate-zoom/band/NaN/snapshot-combo usage arms and the new demo.zoom default altitude are exercised only by manual strips; no CI leg (odin test harness, palcheck, corpus) runs the CLI parser.
recommended_fix: Extract the option walk into a testable harness proc; unit-pin duplicate zoom= -> usage, zoom=0.5/NaN -> usage, snapshot+zoom combo, and override-beats-demo.zoom precedence.

title: Envelope pins pass at advance=3 — the per-tick waveform walk is unpinned mid-phase
evidence:
app/render/view.odin:936:
	idx := (tick + u64(node_id) * 5) * u64(advance) & 15
app/render/look_l1_test.odin:268:
	expect_f32(t, congestion_pulse_share(&v, 8, 0), CONGESTION_PULSE_PEAK_SHARE) // PULSE16[8] == 1.0
detail: At advance=3, tick 8 -> 24&15=8 and 0 -> 0, so every endpoint pin (unit test + palcheck ticks 1000/992) still passes while the envelope jumps 3 table entries/tick — same 16-tick period, different waveform. No mid-phase tick discriminates.
recommended_fix: Add one mid-phase unit pin, e.g. expect_f32(t, congestion_pulse_share(&v, 4, 0), 0.43 + (0.75-0.43)*0.71) — PULSE16[4]; fails under any advance != 1 walk.

title: Routed branch pinned only at amber-peak and calm — routed-RED and routed-trough combos unpinned
detail: Leg (d) renders only .Amber; a routed-branch token mixup (state_congested drawn for .Red) or trough-share drift fails no gate, and the flags-off golden corpus never exercises the routed path.
recommended_fix: Mirror leg (b) inside the routed block: set .Red at peak_tick and scan for peak_red/core_red widths; optionally add a routed trough leg mirroring (f).
